reason: I'm not dropping the electrician or the tuition guy I already trust, but for something new I need and don't have a regular person for, verified profiles beat calling five JustDial numbers and getting two dead ones.
objection: I already have someone I call for this -- why switch? My usual contacts answer and show up, so there's no real reason to risk an app for the services I've already got sorted.
would_change_my_mind: If my regular contacts stop picking up, or I need a service category I don't already have a trusted person for, I'd try booking it on the app instead of starting the JustDial calling routine from scratch.
